headline: Discovery Call Execution Framework: 7-part script, 4 validation questions, tracker template, and go/pivot/no-go criteria.
highlights: 7-part discovery call script with embedded WTP methodology (Parts 2A–2G)
4 validation questions operationalized: brand-fidelity (1–5), 10-min provisioning (1–5), $24K WTP signal (yes/conditional/no), $4,800 pilot intent (yes/maybe/no)
Call tracker template with 40+ structured fields for persona fit, objections, feature requests, and next-step commitments
Go/Pivot/No-Go decision framework with explicit CONFIRM/REFUTE criteria for ≥3 calls (Parts 5–6)
Production-ready playbook: pre-call prep, execution checklist, post-call handoff, recording consent, Zoom integration notes
Maya Chen persona reference, competitor positioning, Pilot Agreement template outline, facilitation training notes
Real-time call log structure (3 call template blocks) with synthesis section for quantitative results and qualitative insights
